scope.zh: 追踪与AI基础设施直接相关的开放标准、联盟与厂商互连项目：它们决定芯粒、内存、纵向/横向网络如何互联。每条标注版本日期、证据级别与未核实之处。
scope.en: Tracks open standards, consortia and vendor interconnect programmes that bear on AI infrastructure: how chiplets, memory and scale-up / scale-out networks connect. Each entry carries a version date, an evidence level and what was not verified.

primary-read.zh: 已打开并阅读官方/参与方原始文件
primary-read.en: Official or participant primary document opened and read

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方文件，细节取自摘要
primary-located.en: Official document located; details from summaries

secondary.zh: 媒体或二手摘要，未核对原文
secondary.en: Press or secondary summaries; primary text not checked

summary.zh: 面向AI算力池内加速器与交换机的低延迟、高带宽互连：200G每通道，单个计算池最多1,024个加速器；提供读、写与原子事务的加载/存储协议。
summary.en: Low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnect between accelerators and switches in an AI pod: 200G per lane, up to 1,024 accelerators per pod, with a load/store protocol using read, write and atomic transactions.

facts.zh: 联盟新闻稿称代表85家以上成员公司。
facts.en: The press release says the consortium represents more than 85 member companies.

facts.zh: 新闻稿称其设计目标为93%有效峰值带宽（联盟自述，未经独立验证）。
facts.en: The release cites 93% effective peak bandwidth as a design aim (consortium claim, not independently verified).

caveat.zh: 据单一来源，2026年4月出现2.0版；本页未核实。
caveat.en: One secondary source mentions a 2.0 version in April 2026; not verified here.

status.zh: 1.0 规范发布（其后另有点版本）

summary.zh: 以以太网为基础的通信栈，覆盖网卡、交换机、光模块与线缆等各层；把现代RDMA带到以太网与IP，并强调到百万级端点的端到端扩展与多厂商互操作。
summary.en: An Ethernet-based communication stack spanning NICs, switches, optics and cables; brings modern RDMA to Ethernet and IP, and stresses end-to-end scaling to millions of endpoints and multi-vendor interoperability.

facts.zh: 发布页未给出成员数量。
facts.en: The release page does not state a member count.

facts.zh: 规范站点已列出后续点版本（如 1.0.2），当前下载并非2025年6月原版（据检索结果）。
facts.en: The specification site lists later point releases (e.g. 1.0.2), so the current download is not the June 2025 build (per search results).

caveat.zh: 页数（562页）等细节来自第三方。
caveat.en: Details such as the 562-page length come from third parties.

date_note.zh: 发布日期取自新闻与百科类来源；联盟博客发表于2025-09-03。
date_note.en: Release date taken from news and encyclopaedic sources; the consortium blog is dated 2025-09-03.

summary.zh: 开放芯粒互连标准：数据速率提升至48与64 GT/s（2.0为32 GT/s），适用于2D（UCIe-S）与2.5D（UCIe-A）封装；完全向后兼容；侧带距离扩展到100 mm，并增加多芯片SiP的固件管理与紧急控制。
summary.en: Open chiplet interconnect standard: data rates rise to 48 and 64 GT/s (2.0 was 32 GT/s) for 2D (UCIe-S) and 2.5D (UCIe-A) packaging; fully backward compatible; sideband reach extends to 100 mm, with firmware management and emergency controls for multi-chip SiPs.

caveat.zh: 只读取了联盟博客，未读取规范本身。
caveat.en: Only the consortium blog was read, not the specification.

hotchips.title: Packaging needs economic and test evidence.
Integration adds power, test and trust gates.

summary.zh: 开放的一致性互连：新增用于内存分层的热页监测单元（CHMU）、通用事件记录、在线固件激活，并通过可信安全协议（TSP）扩展安全；与此前所有CXL规范完全向后兼容。
summary.en: Open coherent interconnect: adds a Hot-Page Monitoring Unit (CHMU) for memory tiering, common event records, online firmware activation and extends security through the Trusted Security Protocol (TSP); fully backward compatible with all earlier CXL specifications.

caveat.zh: 仅一份百科类来源称CXL 4.0已于2025年11月18日发布（128 GT/s）；本页未核实。
caveat.en: Only an encyclopaedic source says CXL 4.0 was released on 18 Nov 2025 (128 GT/s); not verified here.

hotchips.title: Scale depends on mapping and coordination
Memory placement and coherence drew sustained probing.
Memory expansion needed an access model.

summary.zh: 2048位接口，引脚速率最高8 Gb/s，单堆栈最高约2 TB/s；独立通道由16个增至32个（各含2个伪通道）；堆叠4–16层，裸片24 Gb或32 Gb；接口定义保持与HBM3控制器的向后兼容。
summary.en: 2048-bit interface, up to 8 Gb/s per pin, up to about 2 TB/s per stack; independent channels double from 16 to 32 (two pseudo-channels each); 4- to 16-high stacks of 24 Gb or 32 Gb dies; the interface keeps backward compatibility with HBM3 controllers.

facts.zh: JEDEC网站在此环境返回403，数值取自对JEDEC新闻稿的转述报道。
facts.en: The JEDEC site returned 403 here; figures come from reports restating JEDEC's release.

sources.label: EE Times Asia: JEDEC releases JESD270-4

caveat.zh: 个别设计指南给出不同引脚速率范围（含厂商实现），以JEDEC文本为准。
caveat.en: Some design guides quote different pin-speed ranges (vendor implementations); JEDEC's text governs.

hotchips.title: Memory choice follows workload and economics.
Feed the accelerator before judging arithmetic.
Memory placement and coherence drew sustained probing.

summary.zh: 128 GT/s每通道原始速率，x16双向最高约512 GB/s；采用PAM4与flit编码；保持向后兼容；另有光学感知重定时器ECN。PCI-SIG路线图提到8.0（256 GT/s）计划于2028年前发布。
summary.en: 128 GT/s raw rate per lane, up to about 512 GB/s bidirectional at x16; PAM4 signalling with flit encoding; backward compatible; an Optical Aware Retimer ECN is separate. The PCI-SIG roadmap mentions 8.0 (256 GT/s) planned by 2028.

sources.label: PCI-SIG press release via Business Wire

caveat.zh: 新闻稿在此环境无法打开，数值取自多家媒体转述。
caveat.en: The press release could not be opened here; figures come from several outlets restating it.

date_note.zh: 日期为Meta工程博客日期；ESUN于2025年OCP全球峰会宣布。
date_note.en: Date is that of Meta's engineering post; ESUN was announced at the 2025 OCP Global Summit.

status.zh: 工作组（规范状态未核实）

summary.zh: ESUN（以太网扩展纵向网络）是OCP网络项目中的新工作组，目标是把成熟的以太网生态改造用于AI纵向扩展域：协议头、错误处理、无损传输、以太网帧与交换层；并与UEC、IEEE对齐、避免专有绑定。Broadcom贡献的SUE规范演进为SUE-T工作组（据检索结果）。
summary.en: ESUN (Ethernet for Scale-Up Networking) is a new workstream in the OCP Networking Project that adapts the mature Ethernet ecosystem to AI scale-up domains: protocol headers, error handling, lossless transfer, Ethernet framing and switching layers; it aims to align with UEC and IEEE and avoid proprietary ties. Broadcom's SUE contribution evolved into the SUE-T workstream (per search results).

facts.en: Participants named in Meta's post: AMD, Arista, Arm, Broadcom, Cisco, HPE, Marvell, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Oracle.

sources.label: Engineering at Meta: OCP Summit 2025 networking
Broadcom: Introducing Ethernet Scale Up Networking

caveat.zh: SUE/SUE-T与ESUN的分工取自检索摘要，Broadcom博客正文在此环境未能读取。
caveat.en: The SUE/SUE-T versus ESUN split comes from search summaries; the Broadcom post body could not be read here.

status.zh: NVIDIA 合作项目（非联盟标准）
status.en: NVIDIA partner programme (not a consortium standard)

summary.zh: 让合作伙伴围绕NVLink构建半定制AI基础设施的方案；首批采用者包括联发科、Marvell、Alchip、Astera Labs、Synopsys与Cadence；富士通与高通表示计划把自研CPU与NVIDIA GPU配对。
summary.en: A programme that lets partners build semi-custom AI infrastructure around NVLink; first adopters named include MediaTek, Marvell, Alchip, Astera Labs, Synopsys and Cadence; Fujitsu and Qualcomm said they plan to pair custom CPUs with NVIDIA GPUs.

caveat.zh: 新闻稿在此环境返回403；伙伴名单取自检索摘要。后续投资与新伙伴消息仅有单一来源，未采纳。
caveat.en: The press release returned 403 here; the partner list comes from search summaries. Later investment and partner news rests on a single source and is not adopted.

note.zh: 两条开放的纵向扩展路径：专用的加载/存储互连 vs 以太网适配。
note.en: Two open scale-up paths: a dedicated load/store interconnect versus an Ethernet adaptation.
ESUN says it will align with UEC and IEEE.

note.zh: 治理方式不同：厂商合作项目 vs 开放联盟。
note.en: Different governance: a vendor partner programme versus an open consortium.

note.zh: 两者都由先进封装决定落地：芯粒互连与HBM堆叠。
note.en: Both depend on advanced packaging: chiplet links and HBM stacks.

note.zh: CXL运行在PCIe物理层之上（据CXL联盟自述的一致性互连定位，细节需读规范）。
note.en: CXL runs over the PCIe physical layer (details need the specifications).
